$$$
					WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy_cte AS (
                        SELECT
                            id,
                            parent_id,
                            1 AS level
                        FROM
                            meta_schema_new.tb_sub_master_attributes
                        WHERE
                        is_deleted = false and id = {?id}

                        UNION ALL

                        SELECT
                            p.id,
                            p.parent_id,
                            c.level + 1
                        FROM
                            meta_schema_new.tb_sub_master_attributes p
                        INNER JOIN hierarchy_cte c ON p.id = c.parent_id
                        WHERE is_deleted = false
                    ),
                    kpi_formula_with_hierarchy AS (
                        SELECT
                            h.id AS hierarchy_id,
                            h.level,
                            k.*,
                            False as default_kpi_settings 
                        FROM
                            hierarchy_cte h
                        JOIN meta_schema_new.tb_kpi_formula k ON k.attribute_id = h.id
                        where is_deleted = false

                        UNION ALL

                        SELECT
                            -1 AS hierarchy_id,
                             (select max(level) + 1 from hierarchy_cte) as level,
                            k.*,
                            True as default_kpi_settings 
                        FROM meta_schema_new.tb_kpi_formula k
                        WHERE
                            k.attribute_id = -1 and is_deleted = false
                    ),
                    kpi_config_with_hierarchy AS (
                        SELECT
                            h.id AS hierarchy_id,
                            h.level,
                            k.*,
                            False as default_kpi_settings 
                        FROM
                            hierarchy_cte h
                        JOIN meta_schema_new.tb_kpi_config k ON k.attribute_id = h.id
                        where is_deleted = false

                        UNION ALL

                        SELECT
                            -1 AS hierarchy_id,
                             (select max(level) + 1 from hierarchy_cte) as level,
                            k.*,
                            True as default_kpi_settings 
                        FROM meta_schema_new.tb_kpi_config k
                        WHERE
                            k.attribute_id = -1 and is_deleted = false
                    ),
                    selected_kpis_formulas AS (
                        select * FROM
                    	(SELECT
                            k.*,
                            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k.kpi_id ORDER BY k.level asc) as rn
                        FROM
                            kpi_formula_with_hierarchy k) ranked_kpis_formulas
                           where rn = 1
                    ),
                    selected_kpis_configs AS (
                        select * FROM
                    	(SELECT
                            k.*,
                            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k.kpi_id ORDER BY k.level asc) as rn
                        FROM
                            kpi_config_with_hierarchy k) ranked_kpis_configs
                           where rn = 1
                    )
                    select  rkf.kpi_id,tkm."name",skc.label,rkf.update_spread_logic, rkf.update_formula,
                    rkf.product_roll_down, rkf.roll_down_timeline
                    from selected_kpis_formulas rkf
                    left join meta_schema_new.tb_kpi_master tkm on rkf.kpi_id = tkm.id
                    left join selected_kpis_configs skc on skc.kpi_id = rkf.kpi_id
            $$$

$$$with recursive hierarchy_cte as
                (
                    select id, parent_id, 1 as level
                    from meta_schema_new.tb_sub_master_attributes
                    where is_deleted = false and id = {?id}
                    union all
                    select p.id, p.parent_id, c.level - 1
                    from meta_schema_new.tb_sub_master_attributes p
                    inner join hierarchy_cte c on p.id = c.parent_id
                    where is_deleted = false
                ),
                kpi_with_hierarchy as
                (
                    select h.id as hierarchy_id, h.level, k.*, false as default_kpi_settings
                    from hierarchy_cte h
                    join meta_schema_new.tb_kpi_config k on k.attribute_id = h.id
                    where is_deleted = false {p1}
                    union all
                    select -1 as hierarchy_id, -100 as level, /* level as -100 as recursive cte can be called maximum 100 times by default */
                    k.*, true as default_kpi_settings
                    from meta_schema_new.tb_kpi_config k
                    where is_deleted = false and k.attribute_id = -1 {p1}
                ),
                ranked_kpis as
                (
                    select k.*, row_number() over (partition by k.kpi_id order by k.level desc) as rn
                    from kpi_with_hierarchy k 
                ),
                editableflowmaster as
                (
                    select A.kpi_id, json_agg(A.editable_flow) editable_flow
                    from
                        (
                            select rk.kpi_id,
                                jsonb_build_object
                                (
                                    'lock_and_hold' ,

                                     'name',

                                    (
                                        jsonb_build_object
                                        (
                                            'kpi_calculate_id',
                                            efm.kpi_to_calculate,
                                            'kpi_calculate_name',
                                            km.name,
                                            'formula',
                                            (
                                                        select
                                                            replace
                                                            (
                                                                STRING_AGG
                                                                (
                                                                    coalesce
                                                                    (
                                                                        (
                                                                            select
                                                                                '''' || name || ''''
                                                                            from

with recursive hierarchy_cte as
                (
                    select id, parent_id, 1 as level

                    where is_deleted = false and id = {?id}
                    union all
                    select p.id, p.parent_id, c.level - 1

                    where is_deleted = false
                ),
                kpi_with_hierarchy as

                    select h.id as hierarchy_id, h.level, k.*, false as default_kpi_settings
                    from hierarchy_cte h
                    join meta_schema.tb_kpi_config k on k.attribute_id = h.id
                    where is_deleted = false
                    union all
                    select -1 as hierarchy_id, -100 as level, /* level as -100 as recursive cte can be called maximum 100 times by default */
                    k.*, true as default_kpi_settings
                    from meta_schema.tb_kpi_config k
                    where is_deleted = false and k.attribute_id = -1
                ),
                ranked_kpis as
                (
                    select k.*, row_number() over (partition by k.kpi_id order by k.level desc) as rn

$$$
					WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy_cte AS (
                        SELECT
                            id,
                            parent_id,
                            1 AS level
                        FROM
                            meta_schema_new.tb_sub_master_attributes
                        WHERE
                        is_deleted = false and id = {?id}

                        UNION ALL

                        SELECT
                            p.id,
                            p.parent_id,
                            c.level + 1
                        FROM
                            meta_schema_new.tb_sub_master_attributes p
                        INNER JOIN hierarchy_cte c ON p.id = c.parent_id
                        WHERE is_deleted = false
                    ),
                    kpi_formula_with_hierarchy AS (
                        SELECT
                            h.id AS hierarchy_id,
                            h.level,
                            k.*,
                            False as default_kpi_settings 
                        FROM
                            hierarchy_cte h
                        JOIN meta_schema_new.tb_kpi_formula k ON k.attribute_id = h.id
                        where is_deleted = false

                        UNION ALL

                        SELECT
                            -1 AS hierarchy_id,
                             (select max(level) + 1 from hierarchy_cte) as level,
                            k.*,
                            True as default_kpi_settings 
                        FROM meta_schema_new.tb_kpi_formula k
                        WHERE
                            k.attribute_id = -1 and is_deleted = false
                    ),
                    kpi_config_with_hierarchy AS (
                        SELECT
                            h.id AS hierarchy_id,
                            h.level,
                            k.*,
                            False as default_kpi_settings 
                        FROM
                            hierarchy_cte h
                        JOIN meta_schema_new.tb_kpi_config k ON k.attribute_id = h.id
                        where is_deleted = false

                        UNION ALL

                        SELECT
                            -1 AS hierarchy_id,
                             (select max(level) + 1 from hierarchy_cte) as level,
                            k.*,
                            True as default_kpi_settings 
                        FROM meta_schema_new.tb_kpi_config k
                        WHERE
                            k.attribute_id = -1 and is_deleted = false
                    ),
                    selected_kpis_formulas AS (
                        select * FROM
                    	(SELECT
                            k.*,
                            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k.kpi_id ORDER BY k.level asc) as rn
                        FROM
                            kpi_formula_with_hierarchy k) ranked_kpis_formulas
                           where rn = 1
                    ),
                    selected_kpis_configs AS (
                        select * FROM
                    	(SELECT
                            k.*,
                            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k.kpi_id ORDER BY k.level asc) as rn
                        FROM
                            kpi_config_with_hierarchy k) ranked_kpis_configs
                           where rn = 1
                    )
                    select  rkf.kpi_id,tkm."name",skc.label,rkf.prd_hcrchy_agg_formula,
                    rkf.download_week_aggregation_formula, rkf.download_month_aggregation_formula,
                    rkf.roll_up_product_hierarchy,rkf.roll_up_timeline
                    from selected_kpis_formulas rkf
                    left join meta_schema_new.tb_kpi_master tkm on rkf.kpi_id = tkm.id
                    left join selected_kpis_configs skc on skc.kpi_id = rkf.kpi_id
            $$$
